In today's episode of The Daily Brief, we cover two stories shaping Indian and global markets:
1. Brexit at 10: The Hidden Cost of Trade Friction
Ten years after Brexit, Britain's economy is still feeling the impact. We explain how even without tariffs, new paperwork, border checks and regulatory barriers have made trade more expensive, slowed exports, and hurt productivity—showing why reducing trade friction matters for every economy.
